          nt = heavy ? ht_ : t                            # nailer thickness (38 mm build: the heavy board)
          lw = f('bed_ledge_w')
          cmax = zs - NAILER_H - 10
          if jp
            # the frame stands on the floor: the red skirt (floor → under the ledge supports) is the clearance
            c = heavy ? zt - ht_ : zt - 2 * t
            warn('Bed: the Japanese style is drawn for 18 mm board — the construction for other thicknesses is not done yet.') if !heavy && (t - 18).abs > 0.5
          elsif c > cmax
            warn("Bed: a #{fmt c} mm floor clearance does not fit under this height — #{fmt [cmax, 0].max} mm used.")
            c = [cmax, 0.0].max
          end
          if jp
            zlow = 0.0
            if heavy
              ox0 = lw; ox1 = w - lw; oy0 = lw; oy1 = d                 # no head rail
              nl = [lw, lw + nt]; nr = [w - lw - nt, w - lw]; ny = [lw, d]
              bed_japanese_heavy(ht_, w, d, zt, fm)
            else
              ox0 = lw; ox1 = w - lw; oy0 = lw; oy1 = d - t        # mattress / deck opening
              nl = [lw, lw + 2 * t]; nr = [w - lw - 2 * t, w - lw]; ny = [lw, d - t]   # double nailers
              bed_japanese(t, w, d, zt, fm, cm)
            end
          else
            ox0 = t; ox1 = w - t; oy0 = t; oy1 = d - t
            nl = [2 * t, 3 * t]; nr = [w - 3 * t, w - 2 * t]; ny = [2 * t, d - 2 * t]
            zlow = c
            bed_frame(t, w, d, zt, zs, c, fm, cm, st == 'simple')
            bed_base(t, w, d, c, cm) if st == 'floating'
          end
          # nailers on the long sides, flush with the inner rails' tops
          # (Japanese: two side by side, their tops 50 mm under the top ledge)
          [[nl, 'L'], [nr, 'R']].each do |(a, b), sd|
            n = ((b - a) / nt).round
            n.times { |i| panel('Nailer', 'carcass', cm, a + i * nt, a + (i + 1) * nt, ny[0], ny[1], zs - NAILER_H, zs, 'x', 'y', '', 'tag' => n > 1 ? "#{sd}#{i + 1}" : sd) }
          end
          wide = ox1 - ox0 > 1200
          xm = w / 2.0
          if wide
            if heavy      # one heavy board
              panel('Centre beam', 'carcass', cm, xm - hb2, xm + hb2, ny[0], ny[1], zlow, zs, 'x', 'y', '')
            else          # two panels
              panel('Centre beam', 'carcass', cm, xm - t, xm, ny[0], ny[1], zlow, zs, 'x', 'y', '', 'tag' => '1')
              panel('Centre beam', 'carcass', cm, xm, xm + t, ny[0], ny[1], zlow, zs, 'x', 'y', '', 'tag' => '2')
            end
            panel('Centre nailer', 'carcass', cm, xm - hb2 - nt, xm - hb2, ny[0], ny[1], zs - NAILER_H, zs, 'x', 'y', '', 'tag' => 'L')
            panel('Centre nailer', 'carcass', cm, xm + hb2, xm + hb2 + nt, ny[0], ny[1], zs - NAILER_H, zs, 'x', 'y', '', 'tag' => 'R')
            if st == 'simple'
              # legs flat against the beam, one each side, up to the nailers; two pairs for a king
              pairs = ox1 - ox0 > 1700 ? [1.0 / 3, 2.0 / 3] : [0.5]
              pairs.each_with_index do |fr, k|
                yc = ny[0] + (ny[1] - ny[0]) * fr
                panel('Centre leg', 'carcass', cm, xm - hb2 - t, xm - hb2, yc - 40, yc + 40, 0, zs - NAILER_H, 'x', 'z', '', 'tag' => "#{k + 1}L")
                panel('Centre leg', 'carcass', cm, xm + hb2, xm + hb2 + t, yc - 40, yc + 40, 0, zs - NAILER_H, 'x', 'z', '', 'tag' => "#{k + 1}R")
              end
              hw('Bed leg screw 4 × 40 mm', 4 * 2 * pairs.size)
            end
          end
          if solid
            # single cross beams, equally spaced, split at the centre beam; the sheet rests on them
            n = ny[1] - ny[0] > 2000 ? 4 : 3
            spans = wide ? [[nl[1], xm - hb2 - nt], [xm + hb2 + nt, nr[0]]] : [[nl[1], nr[0]]]
            n.times do |i|
              yc = ny[0] + (ny[1] - ny[0]) * (i + 1) / (n + 1)
              spans.each_with_index do |(a, b), j|
                panel('Cross beam', 'carcass', cm, a, b, yc - t / 2.0, yc + t / 2.0, zlow, zs, 'y', 'x', '', 'tag' => "#{i + 1}#{wide ? (j.zero? ? 'L' : 'R') : ''}")
              end
            end
            halves = wide ? [[ox0, xm], [xm, ox1]] : [[ox0, ox1]]      # meeting on the centre beam
            halves.each_with_index { |(a, b), i| panel('Deck', 'carcass', cm, a, b, oy0, oy1, zs, zd, 'z', 'y', '', 'tag' => (i + 1).to_s) }
          elsif roll
            # bought slat rolls (look only, not cut): one, or one each side of the centre beam
            spans = wide ? [[ox0, xm], [xm, ox1]] : [[ox0, ox1]]
            spans.each_with_index { |(a, b), i| bed_slat_roll(a, b, oy0, oy1, zs, i + 1) }
            hw("Slatted bed base (roll), #{fmt spans[0][1] - spans[0][0]} × #{fmt oy1 - oy0} mm", spans.size)
          else
            sw = f('bed_slat_w'); sg = f('bed_slat_gap'); len = oy1 - oy0
            n = [((len + sg) / (sw + sg)).ceil, 2].max
            gap = (len - n * sw) / (n - 1)
            n.times do |i|
              ya = oy0 + i * (sw + gap)
              panel('Slat', 'carcass', cm, ox0, ox1, ya, ya + sw, zs, zd, 'z', 'x', '', 'tag' => (i + 1).to_s)
            end
            hw('Bed slat screw 4 × 30 mm', n * (wide ? 3 : 2))
          end
          bed_mattress(ox0 + g, ox1 - g, oy0 + g, oy1 - g, zd, hgt) if @p['bed_mattress']
          hx0 = hbw = nil
          if hb
            ht = f('bed_hb_t')
            hbw = f('bed_hb_w') > 0 ? f('bed_hb_w') : w              # centred on the bed
            hx0 = (w - hbw) / 2.0
            panel('Headboard', 'front', fm, hx0, hx0 + hbw, d, d + ht, 0, hgt + f('bed_hb_h'), 'y', 'x', '1L 2W')
            hw('Screw 4 × 40 mm (headboard to head band)', 6)
          end
          sz = Params::BED_SIZES.find { |_, v| v == [f('bed_mw'), f('bed_ml')] }
          assign_pids
          { 'parts' => @parts, 'warnings' => @warnings, 'hardware' => @hw.to_a, 'movers' => @movers,
            'corner' => nil, 'layout' => [],
            'bed' => { 'style' => st, 'size' => sz ? sz[0] : 'custom', 'mattress' => [r(f('bed_mw')), r(f('bed_ml')), r(mt)],
                       'opening' => [r(ox1 - ox0), r(oy1 - oy0)], 'deck' => r(zd), 'support' => r(zs), 'top' => r(zt),
                       'recess' => r(zt - zd), 'clear' => r(c), 'ledge_t' => jp ? r(zt - c) : nil, 'build' => heavy ? '38' : nil,
                       'height' => r(hgt), 'width' => r(w),
                       'headboard' => hb ? [r(hx0), r(hx0 + hbw), r(hgt + f('bed_hb_h'))] : nil,
                       'notch' => heavy ? { 'kind' => 'butt', 't' => r(ht_), 'ledge' => r(lw), 'side' => r(lw), 'ear' => r(lw - ht_), 'mid' => r(w), 'length' => r(w) } :
                                  jp ? { 't' => r(t), 'ledge' => r(lw), 'side' => r(lw - t), 'ear' => r(lw - t), 'mid' => r(w - 2 * (lw - t)), 'length' => r(w) } : nil },
            'bbox' => bbox, 'params' => @p }
        end

        # Decorative rails (fronts material): the foot one full width over the sides' ends, the head
        # band between the sides. Inner rails inside them, bottoms flush, tops at the support height:
        # the end ones across, the side ones between. With legs: an L in each inside corner, against
        # the inner rails, under the nailer, from the floor up to the nailer.
        def bed_frame(t, w, d, zt, zs, c, fm, cm, legs)
          panel('Skirt', 'front', fm, 0, w, 0, t, c, zt, 'y', 'x', '2L 2W', 'tag' => 'F')
          panel('Skirt', 'front', fm, 0, t, t, d, c, zt, 'x', 'y', '2L', 'tag' => 'L')
          panel('Skirt', 'front', fm, w - t, w, t, d, c, zt, 'x', 'y', '2L', 'tag' => 'R')
          panel('Head band', 'front', fm, t, w - t, d - t, d, c, zt, 'y', 'x', '2L')
          panel('End rail', 'carcass', cm, t, w - t, t, 2 * t, c, zs, 'y', 'x', '', 'tag' => 'F')
          panel('End rail', 'carcass', cm, t, w - t, d - 2 * t, d - t, c, zs, 'y', 'x', '', 'tag' => 'H')
          panel('Side rail', 'carcass', cm, t, 2 * t, 2 * t, d - 2 * t, c, zs, 'x', 'y', '', 'tag' => 'L')
          panel('Side rail', 'carcass', cm, w - 2 * t, w - t, 2 * t, d - 2 * t, c, zs, 'x', 'y', '', 'tag' => 'R')
          hw('Bed corner bracket', 4)
          return unless legs
          lw = f('bed_leg_w'); ztop = zs - NAILER_H
          [[:l, 2 * t, 3 * t, 3 * t, 2 * t + lw], [:r, w - 3 * t, w - 2 * t, w - 2 * t - lw, w - 3 * t]].each do |sd, ax0, ax1, bx0, bx1|
            [[:f, 2 * t, 2 * t + lw, 2 * t, 3 * t], [:h, d - 2 * t - lw, d - 2 * t, d - 3 * t, d - 2 * t]].each do |en, ay0, ay1, by0, by1|
              tag = "#{sd == :l ? 'L' : 'R'}#{en == :f ? 'F' : 'H'}"
              panel('Leg', 'carcass', cm, ax0, ax1, ay0, ay1, 0, ztop, 'x', 'z', '1L', 'tag' => tag)
              panel('Leg', 'carcass', cm, bx0, bx1, by0, by1, 0, ztop, 'y', 'z', '1L', 'tag' => tag)
            end
          end
          hw('Bed leg screw 4 × 40 mm', 4 * 8)
        end

        # A bought slat roll, look only: arched slats with rounded ends on two straps underneath.
        def bed_slat_roll(a, b, y0, y1, z0, k)
          rt = f('bed_roll_t'); sw = f('bed_roll_w'); sg = f('bed_roll_gap'); rise = f('bed_roll_rise')
          len = y1 - y0
          n = [((len + sg) / (sw + sg)).floor, 2].max
          gap = (len - n * sw) / (n - 1)
          seg = 10
          zb = ->(x) { z0 + rise * Math.sin(Math::PI * (x - a) / (b - a)) }
          bot = (0..seg).map { |i| x = a + (b - a) * i / seg; [x, zb.(x)] }
          prof = bot + bot.reverse.map { |x, z| [x, z + rt] }
          ex = { 'cut' => false, 'tag' => k.to_s }
          n.times do |i|
            ya = y0 + i * (sw + gap)
            prism('Slat (roll)', 'hardware', Params::SLAT_ROLL_MAT, 'y', ya, sw, prof, 'x', '', ex)
          end
          [0.18, 0.82].each do |fr|
            x = a + (b - a) * fr
            z = zb.(x)
            panel('Slat roll strap', 'hardware', Params::STRAP_MAT, x - 20, x + 20, y0 + 5, y1 - 5, z - 1.5, z, 'z', 'y', '', ex)
          end
        end

        # The mattress, look only: rounded corners, a piped border near the top and a quilted
        # top of soft panels (the gaps between them show as the quilting seams).
        def bed_mattress(x0, x1, y0, y1, z0, z1)
          mm = Params::MATTRESS_MAT
          hwx = { 'cut' => false }
          q = 20.0                                     # quilted layer
          prism('Mattress', 'hardware', mm, 'z', z0, z1 - z0 - q, rrect(x0, y0, x1, y1, 55), 'x', '', hwx)
          prism('Mattress piping', 'hardware', Params::MATTRESS_TRIM, 'z', z1 - q - 6, 6, rrect(x0 - 3, y0 - 3, x1 + 3, y1 + 3, 58), 'x', '', hwx)
          nx = [((x1 - x0) / 230.0).round, 2].max
          ny = [((y1 - y0) / 230.0).round, 2].max
          gp = 8.0
          cw = (x1 - x0 - 2 * 12 - (nx - 1) * gp) / nx
          ch = (y1 - y0 - 2 * 12 - (ny - 1) * gp) / ny
          nx.times do |i|
            ny.times do |j|
              a = x0 + 12 + i * (cw + gp)
              b = y0 + 12 + j * (ch + gp)
              prism('Mattress quilt', 'hardware', mm, 'z', z1 - q, q, rrect(a, b, a + cw, b + ch, 22), 'x', '', hwx)
            end
          end
        end

        # Rounded rectangle (plan), 4 segments per corner.
        def rrect(x0, y0, x1, y1, rad)
          rad = [rad, (x1 - x0) / 2.0, (y1 - y0) / 2.0].min
          out = []
          [[x1 - rad, y0 + rad, -90], [x1 - rad, y1 - rad, 0], [x0 + rad, y1 - rad, 90], [x0 + rad, y0 + rad, 180]].each do |cx, cy, a0|
            5.times do |k|
              a = (a0 + k * 22.5) * Math::PI / 180
              out << [cx + rad * Math.cos(a), cy + rad * Math.sin(a)]
            end
          end
          out
        end

        # Floating: a base box set back on both sides and the foot (head flush), and flat bearers on it
        # that carry the frame (its bottom edge at the floor clearance).
        def bed_base(t, w, d, c, cm)
          sb = f('bed_setback')
          raise BuildError, 'Bed: the base set-back is too large for this bed.' if w - 2 * sb < 300 || d - sb < 300
          bh = c - t
          if bh < 40
            warn('Bed: the base is only ' + fmt([bh, 0].max) + ' mm high — raise the floor clearance (base height).')
            return if bh < 10
          end
          bm = s('mat_kick')
          panel('Base side', 'base', bm, sb, sb + t, sb, d, 0, bh, 'x', 'y', '1L', 'tag' => 'L')
          panel('Base side', 'base', bm, w - sb - t, w - sb, sb, d, 0, bh, 'x', 'y', '1L', 'tag' => 'R')
          panel('Base front', 'base', bm, sb + t, w - sb - t, sb, sb + t, 0, bh, 'y', 'x', '1L')
          panel('Base back', 'base', bm, sb + t, w - sb - t, d - t, d, 0, bh, 'y', 'x', '')
          panel('Base spine', 'base', bm, w / 2.0 - t / 2.0, w / 2.0 + t / 2.0, sb + t, d - t, 0, bh, 'x', 'y', '') if w - 2 * t > 1200
          ya = t; yb = d - t - 100
          n = [((yb - ya) / 600.0).ceil, 1].max
          (0..n).each do |i|
            y = ya + (yb - ya) * i / n
            panel('Bearer', 'carcass', s('mat_carcass'), t, w - t, y, y + 100, bh, c, 'z', 'x', '', 'tag' => (i + 1).to_s)
          end
        end

        # Japanese (18 mm board), the frame standing on the floor. From the mattress out:
        #   yellow inner bands (floor → 1 t under the top; the foot and head ones full width over the
        #   side ones' ends) → red skirt outside them (1 t shorter: its height is the floor clearance)
        #   → purple ledge supports lying on the red, butted against the yellow → teal top ledge bands
        #   on top, from the yellow's inner face out (the ledge width). No ledge at the head.
        #   The foot support runs the full ledge width and is (ledge) wide, notched by hand t deep
        #   along the yellow so it keeps an ear at each end that the side supports butt into (biscuit).
        def bed_japanese(t, w, d, zt, fm, cm)
          lw = f('bed_ledge_w')
          zy = zt - t                # yellow and purple tops / teal underside
          zr = zt - 2 * t            # red top / purple underside
          x0 = lw; x1 = w - lw       # yellow inner faces
          # yellow
          panel('End rail', 'carcass', cm, x0 - t, x1 + t, lw - t, lw, 0, zy, 'y', 'x', '', 'tag' => 'F')
          panel('End rail', 'carcass', cm, x0 - t, x1 + t, d - t, d, 0, zy, 'y', 'x', '', 'tag' => 'H')
          panel('Side rail', 'carcass', cm, x0 - t, x0, lw, d - t, 0, zy, 'x', 'y', '', 'tag' => 'L')
          panel('Side rail', 'carcass', cm, x1, x1 + t, lw, d - t, 0, zy, 'x', 'y', '', 'tag' => 'R')
          # red skirt: the foot one over the sides' ends; none at the head
          panel('Skirt', 'front', fm, x0 - 2 * t, x1 + 2 * t, lw - 2 * t, lw - t, 0, zr, 'y', 'x', '1L 2W', 'tag' => 'F')
          panel('Skirt', 'front', fm, x0 - 2 * t, x0 - t, lw - t, d, 0, zr, 'x', 'y', '1L', 'tag' => 'L')
          panel('Skirt', 'front', fm, x1 + t, x1 + 2 * t, lw - t, d, 0, zr, 'x', 'y', '1L', 'tag' => 'R')
          # purple supports: foot one notched (ears over the overhang reach the yellow's inner face)
          ear = lw - t
          note = "notch #{fmt t} deep × #{fmt w - 2 * ear} mm along the inner edge by hand, leaving #{fmt ear} mm ears at both ends — see the plan"
          foot = [[0, 0], [w, 0], [w, lw], [w - ear, lw], [w - ear, lw - t], [ear, lw - t], [ear, lw], [0, lw]]
          prism('Ledge support', 'front', fm, 'z', zr, t, foot, 'x', '1L 2W', 'tag' => 'F', 'note' => note)
          panel('Ledge support', 'front', fm, 0, ear, lw, d, zr, zy, 'z', 'y', '1L 1W', 'tag' => 'L')
          panel('Ledge support', 'front', fm, w - ear, w, lw, d, zr, zy, 'z', 'y', '1L 1W', 'tag' => 'R')
          # teal top ledge bands: the foot one full width, the sides butt into it
          panel('Ledge', 'front', fm, 0, w, 0, lw, zy, zt, 'z', 'x', '2L 2W', 'tag' => 'F')
          panel('Ledge', 'front', fm, 0, lw, lw, d, zy, zt, 'z', 'y', '2L 1W', 'tag' => 'L')
          panel('Ledge', 'front', fm, w - lw, w, lw, d, zy, zt, 'z', 'y', '2L 1W', 'tag' => 'R')
          hw('Biscuit (ledge support corner)', 2)
          hw('Bed corner bracket', 4)
        end

        # Japanese, 38 mm construction: single heavy rails on the floor (the foot one full width over
        # the sides' ends, none at the head) and the top ledge bands lying on them, inner edges flush
        # with the rails' inside faces; the foot band full width, the side bands butt into it.
        def bed_japanese_heavy(ht, w, d, zt, fm)
          lw = f('bed_ledge_w')
          zr = zt - ht
          panel('Skirt', 'front', fm, lw - ht, w - lw + ht, lw - ht, lw, 0, zr, 'y', 'x', '1L 2W', 'tag' => 'F')
          panel('Skirt', 'front', fm, lw - ht, lw, lw, d, 0, zr, 'x', 'y', '1L', 'tag' => 'L')
          panel('Skirt', 'front', fm, w - lw, w - lw + ht, lw, d, 0, zr, 'x', 'y', '1L', 'tag' => 'R')
          panel('Ledge', 'front', fm, 0, w, 0, lw, zr, zt, 'z', 'x', '2L 2W', 'tag' => 'F')
          panel('Ledge', 'front', fm, 0, lw, lw, d, zr, zt, 'z', 'y', '2L 1W', 'tag' => 'L')
          panel('Ledge', 'front', fm, w - lw, w, lw, d, zr, zt, 'z', 'y', '2L 1W', 'tag' => 'R')
          hw('Bed corner bracket', 4)
        end

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------ loose panel
        # One panel on its own, placed and stretched like a module: a top (overpanel) lying over
        # several modules, an end panel standing beside them, a filler closing a gap at the front,
        # or a back cover. W × H × D is the panel's outside; the thickness is one of them.
        PANEL_NAMES = { 'top' => 'Overpanel', 'bottom' => 'Underpanel', 'side' => 'End panel', 'filler' => 'Filler',
                        'back' => 'Back cover', 'crown' => 'Crown' }.freeze
        PANEL_EB = { 'front' => '1L', 'long' => '2L', 'all' => '2L 2W', 'none' => '' }.freeze
        def build_panel
          t = f('panel_t'); w = f('width'); h = f('height'); d = f('depth')
          raise BuildError, 'Panel thickness must be greater than zero.' if t <= 0
          kind = s('panel_kind')
          name = PANEL_NAMES[kind]
          eb = PANEL_EB[s('panel_eb')] || ''
          mat = %w[top bottom].include?(kind) ? s('mat_top') : s('mat_skin')
          # A loose panel is given as Length × Width × Thickness: the grain runs along its Length,
          # and the cut list keeps it (L = Length) whatever the "longest side" rule.
          keep = { 'keep_grain' => true }
          case kind
          when 'top', 'bottom'
            panel(name, 'skin', mat, 0, w, 0, d, 0, t, 'z', 'x', eb, keep)
            grain_marks('z', t, [0, w], [0, d], 0)
          when 'side'
            panel(name, 'skin', mat, 0, t, 0, d, 0, h, 'x', 'z', eb, keep)
            grain_marks('x', t, [0, d], [0, h], 1)
          else
            panel(name, 'skin', mat, 0, w, 0, t, 0, h, 'y', 'x', eb, keep)
            grain_marks('y', -0.8, [0, w], [0, h], 0)
          end
          assign_pids
          { 'parts' => @parts, 'warnings' => @warnings, 'hardware' => @hw.to_a, 'movers' => @movers,
            'corner' => nil, 'layout' => [], 'bbox' => bbox, 'params' => @p }
        end

        # Grain arrows drawn on a loose panel's face in the previews (never cut, never in the
        # SketchUp model or the 2D drawings): three lines and an arrow head along the grain.
        # face: the plane's position across `axis`; ur / vr: the face's extent along its two
        # axes (plane_axes order); along: 0 = grain along the first, 1 = along the second.
        def grain_marks(axis, face, ur, vr, along)
          a = along.zero? ? ur : vr
          b = along.zero? ? vr : ur
          la = a[1] - a[0]
          lb = b[1] - b[0]
          return if la < 60 || lb < 30
          head = [[lb * 0.12, la * 0.06].min, 60.0].min
          wline = [[lb * 0.008, 1.5].max, 4.0].min
          x0 = a[0] + la * 0.18
          x1 = a[1] - la * 0.18 - head
          ex = { 'cut' => false, 'deco' => 'grain', 'role' => 'hardware' }
          pos = face >= 0 ? face + 0.2 : face
          [0.3, 0.5, 0.7].each do |fr|
            c = b[0] + lb * fr
            q = [[x0, c - wline], [x1, c - wline], [x1, c + wline], [x0, c + wline]]
            q = q.map { |pt| along.zero? ? pt : [pt[1], pt[0]] }
            prism('Grain', 'hardware', Params::METAL, axis, pos, 0.6, q, along.zero? ? plane_axes(axis)[0] : plane_axes(axis)[1], '', ex)
          end
          c = b[0] + lb * 0.5
          tri = [[x1, c - head * 0.6], [x1 + head, c], [x1, c + head * 0.6]].map { |pt| along.zero? ? pt : [pt[1], pt[0]] }
          prism('Grain', 'hardware', Params::METAL, axis, pos, 0.6, tri, plane_axes(axis)[along], '', ex)
        end

        # Drawers opened for show: in each column the top drawer comes out least and each one
        # below a little further (35 % … 65 % of its pull-out), like a staircase.
        STAIR_LO = 0.35
        STAIR_HI = 0.65
        def staircase_drawers
          return false unless s('drawer_open') == 'staircase'
          @movers.select { |m| m['kind'] == 'drawer' && m['at'] }.group_by { |m| m['tag'].to_s[/\A[CN]\d+/] }.each_value do |list|
            list = list.sort_by { |m| -m['at'][1] }
            n = list.size
            list.each_with_index do |m, i|
              frac = n == 1 ? 0.5 : STAIR_LO + (STAIR_HI - STAIR_LO) * i / (n - 1)
              m['travel'] = r(m['travel'].to_f * frac)
            end
          end
          true
        end

        # What 'auto' came out as: each column's clear width and each row's section height
        # (the same measures the Layout tab takes), for the Configurator to show.
        def layout_summary
          (@cols || []).map do |c|
            { 'w' => r(c['x1'] - c['x0']), 'rows' => (c['hs'] || []).map { |h| r(h) } }
          end
        end

        # Move every part (and door / drawer pivots) by (dx, dy, dz) mm.
        def shift_all(dx, dy, dz)
          dv = { 'x' => dx, 'y' => dy, 'z' => dz }
          @parts.each do |pt|
            if pt['shape'] == 'cyl'
              pt['center'] = [pt['center'][0] + dx, pt['center'][1] + dy, pt['center'][2] + dz].map { |v| r(v) }
            else
              u, v = plane_axes(pt['axis'])
              pt['pos'] = r(pt['pos'] + dv[pt['axis']])
              pt['pts'] = pt['pts'].map { |q| [r(q[0] + dv[u]), r(q[1] + dv[v])] }
              (pt['grooves'] || []).each { |ln| ln.each { |q| q[0] = r(q[0] + dv[u]); q[1] = r(q[1] + dv[v]) } }
            end
            if (sl = pt['slide'])
              sl['face_x'] = r(sl['face_x'] + dx); sl['y'] = r(sl['y'] + dy); sl['zc'] = r(sl['zc'] + dz)
            end
            if (hg = pt['hinge'])
              hg['x'] = r(hg['x'] + dx); hg['y'] = r(hg['y'] + dy); hg['z'] = r(hg['z'] + dz)
              hg['side_x'] = r(hg['side_x'] + dx) if hg['side_x']
            end
          end
          @movers.each do |m|
            m['pivot'] = [m['pivot'][0] + dx, m['pivot'][1] + dy, m['pivot'][2] + dz].map { |v| r(v) } if m['pivot']
            m['at'] = [r(m['at'][0] + dx), r(m['at'][1] + dz)] if m['at']
          end
        end

        # Stable id per part ("Side|", "Door|C1R2|0", "Adj. shelf|C1R1|1") so a
        # rebuild can find the same physical panel again (hand-painted materials).
        def assign_pids
          seen = Hash.new(0)
          @parts.each do |pt|
            k = "#{pt['name']}|#{pt['tag']}"
            pt['pid'] = "#{k}|#{seen[k]}"
            seen[k] += 1
          end
        end

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers
        def f(k); @p[k].to_f; end
        def s(k); @p[k].to_s; end
        def r(v); (v.to_f * 10).round / 10.0; end

        def fmt(v)
          v = r(v)
          v == v.to_i ? v.to_i.to_s : v.to_s
        end

        def warn(m); @warnings << m unless @warnings.include?(m); end

        def hw(item, qty)
          return if qty <= 0
          @hw[item] = (@hw[item] || 0) + qty
        end

        def plane_axes(axis)
          case axis
          when 'x' then %w[y z]
          when 'y' then %w[x z]
          else %w[x y]
          end
        end

        # Generic extruded part.
        def prism(name, role, mat, axis, pos, thk, pts, grain, eb, extra = {})
          u, v = plane_axes(axis)
          pts = pts.map { |q| [r(q[0]), r(q[1])] } # round first so cut sizes == drawn sizes
          thk = r(thk)
          us = pts.map { |q| q[0] }
          vs = pts.map { |q| q[1] }
          du = us.max - us.min
          dv = vs.max - vs.min
          if du < 1 || dv < 1 || thk < 0.5
            warn("Skipped '#{name}': it came out too small (#{fmt du}×#{fmt dv}×#{fmt thk} mm).")
            return nil
          end
          # Cut-list length follows the longer side for box parts (edge banding is
          # given per physical edge, so the L/W counts swap with it).
          if pts.size >= 4 && AUTO_GRAIN_ROLES.include?(role) && s('grain_rule') == 'longest' && !extra['keep_grain']
            along, across = grain == u ? [du, dv] : [dv, du]
            if across > along + 0.05
              grain = grain == u ? v : u
              eb = swap_eb(eb)
            end
          end
          len, wid = grain == u ? [du, dv] : [dv, du]
          part = {
            'name' => name, 'role' => role, 'mat' => mat, 'shape' => 'prism',
            'axis' => axis, 'pos' => r(pos), 'thk' => r(thk),
            'pts' => pts.map { |q| [r(q[0]), r(q[1])] },
            'L' => r(len), 'W' => r(wid), 'T' => r(thk), 'grain' => grain, 'eb' => eb, 'cut' => true
          }
          part.merge!(extra)
          @parts << part
          part
        end

        AUTO_GRAIN_ROLES = %w[carcass shelf back drawer base skin].freeze

        # '1L' ↔ '1W', '2L 1W' ↔ '1L 2W' …
        def swap_eb(eb)
          l_n = eb.to_s[/(\d)L/, 1].to_i
          w_n = eb.to_s[/(\d)W/, 1].to_i
          [w_n > 0 ? "#{w_n}L" : nil, l_n > 0 ? "#{l_n}W" : nil].compact.join(' ')
        end

        # Axis-aligned rectangular panel. `thin` is the thickness axis, `grain` the
        # in-plane axis that the grain (cut-list length) runs along.
        def panel(name, role, mat, x0, x1, y0, y1, z0, z1, thin, grain, eb = '', extra = {})
          lo = { 'x' => x0, 'y' => y0, 'z' => z0 }
          hi = { 'x' => x1, 'y' => y1, 'z' => z1 }
          u, v = plane_axes(thin)
          pts = [[lo[u], lo[v]], [hi[u], lo[v]], [hi[u], hi[v]], [lo[u], hi[v]]]
          prism(name, role, mat, thin, lo[thin], hi[thin] - lo[thin], pts, grain, eb, extra)
        end

        def cyl(name, mat, center, axis, radius, length, extra = {})
          part = {
            'name' => name, 'role' => 'hardware', 'mat' => mat, 'shape' => 'cyl',
            'center' => center.map { |c| r(c) }, 'axis' => axis, 'r' => radius, 'len' => r(length), 'cut' => false
          }
          part.merge!(extra)
          @parts << part
        end

        def hardware_box(name, x0, x1, y0, y1, z0, z1, thin, extra = {})
          panel(name, 'hardware', Params::METAL, x0, x1, y0, y1, z0, z1, thin, thin == 'z' ? 'x' : 'y', '', extra.merge('cut' => false))
        end

        # A moving assembly (door or drawer). Parts carry its id in 'mover'.
        # pivot/axis/angle describe the open position for doors (module-local mm,
        # degrees, right-hand rule); travel is the pull-out distance for drawers.
        def add_mover(h)
          @movers << h
          h['id']
        end

        # Split `total` between fixed sizes and 'auto' entries.
        def distribute(specs, total, label)
          fixed = specs.select { |x| x.is_a?(Numeric) }
          fixed_sum = fixed.inject(0.0) { |a, b| a + b }
          autos = specs.size - fixed.size
          if autos > 0
            aw = (total - fixed_sum) / autos
            raise BuildError, "Fixed #{label} (#{fmt fixed_sum} mm) leave no room for the 'auto' ones — only #{fmt total} mm available." if aw < 20
            specs.map { |x| x.is_a?(Numeric) ? x.to_f : aw }
          else
            scale = total / fixed_sum
            warn("#{label.capitalize} (#{fmt fixed_sum} mm) were scaled to fit the #{fmt total} mm available — set one to 'auto' to control this.") if (fixed_sum - total).abs > 0.5
            specs.map { |x| x * scale }
          end
        end

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------ setup
        def setup
          # Decorative side panels: inside the given width (carcass narrows) or added to it.
          @sl = @p['skin_l'] ? f('skin_t') : 0.0
          @sr = @p['skin_r'] ? f('skin_t') : 0.0
          @skin_in = s('skin_fit') == 'inside'
          @W = f('width') - (@skin_in ? @sl + @sr : 0.0); @H = f('height'); @D = f('depth')
          @t = f('t'); @ft = f('front_t'); @gap = f('gap'); @rev = f('reveal')
          raise BuildError, 'Panel thickness must be greater than zero.' if @t <= 0

          @ff = s('construction') == 'face_frame'
          @fft = @ff ? f('ff_t') : 0.0
          @ffov = @ff ? f('ff_overhang') : 0.0
          @st = f('ff_stile'); @rail = f('ff_rail'); @mid = f('ff_mid')
          @ffo = f('ff_overlay'); @ffg = f('ff_inset_gap')
          @cx0 = @ffov; @cx1 = @W - @ffov; @cy0 = @fft

          @nooks = s('layout_mode') == 'nooks' && @p['nooks'].is_a?(Hash)
          if @nooks && s('corner') != 'none' && !s('corner').empty?
            warn('NOOKS are not used on corner modules — the columns and rows are used.')
            @nooks = false
          end
          has_knee = !@nooks && @p['columns'].any? { |c| c['kind'] == 'kneehole' }
          @joint = s('joint')
          # sides_full: sides run down past the bottom, top between them; top_full: same, but the
          # top lies over the sides; bottom_full: bottom under the sides; top_bottom_full: both over
          @sides_low = %w[sides_full top_full].include?(@joint)
          @top_over = %w[top_bottom_full top_full].include?(@joint)
          @kick = s('kick_type')
          @kh = @kick == 'none' ? 0.0 : f('kick_h')
          if has_knee && !@sides_low
            warn('Kneehole layouts are built with sides over the bottom (sides full height).')
            @joint = @top_over ? 'top_full' : 'sides_full'
            @sides_low = true
          end
          if @kick == 'integral' && !@sides_low
            warn('A notched (integral) toe kick needs sides that run to the floor — a separate plinth is used instead.')
            @kick = 'plinth'
          end

          # The module height is the carcass. A decorative top sits on it, outside the height.
          @add_top = @p['add_top']
          # Sides full height: the sides may go up past the top (the top sits between them, lower) and,
          # with no toe kick, the bottom may sit up inside them.
          @dsides = @joint == 'sides_full'
          @side_top = @H
          @top = @dsides ? @H - @p['side_up'].to_f : @H
          @top_set = @dsides && !@p['top_type'].to_s.eql?('stretchers') ? @p['top_setback'].to_f : 0.0
          @top_t = @add_top ? f('top_t') : 0.0
          @base_z = @dsides && @kick == 'none' ? @p['side_down'].to_f : @kh
          @bottom_under = @base_z + (@ff ? [@rail - @t, 0.0].max : 0.0)
          @bottom_top = @bottom_under + @t

          @stretch = s('top_type') == 'stretchers'
          # Front and rear stretchers each flat or on edge, each with its own width.
          @on_edge = s('front_stretcher_orient') == 'on_edge'
          @r_on_edge = s('rear_stretcher_orient') == 'on_edge'
          @sw = f('stretcher_w')
          @rsw = f('rear_stretcher_w')
          @drop = @stretch ? f('stretcher_drop') : 0.0
          front_h = @on_edge ? @sw : @t
          rear_h = @p['rear_stretcher'] ? (@r_on_edge ? @rsw : @t) : 0.0
          @top_under = @stretch ? @top - [front_h, rear_h].max : @top - @t
          @top_edge = @stretch ? @drop + front_h : @t

          @back = s('back_type'); @bt = f('back_t'); @g = f('groove_depth')
          rec = @back == 'applied' ? 0.0 : f('back_recess')
          @y_back_rear = @D - rec
          @y_back_front = @y_back_rear - @bt
          @y_tb_back = case @back
                       when 'groove' then @D
                       when 'inset' then @D   # owner's rule: top and bottom always as deep as the sides; a recessed back sits between them
                       else @D - @bt
                       end
          @side_back = @back == 'applied' ? @D - @bt : @D

          if @back == 'groove'
            warn("Back groove is #{fmt @g} mm deep in #{fmt @t} mm panels — keep it under half the thickness.") if @g > @t / 2.0 + 0.05
            warn("Back groove is only #{fmt rec} mm from the rear edge — that lip may break out.") if rec < 6
          end

          @overlay = s('overlay')
          @inset = @overlay == 'inset'
          @y_int_front = @inset ? [@cy0, @ft].max : @cy0
          @notch = f('kick_setback') + @t   # the toe kick board sits in the notch, its front face the setback behind the carcass front
          @divider = s('row_divider') == 'fixed_shelf'
          @knee_all = s('knee_sides') == 'all'
          @ct_drop = @p['ct_clear'] ? [f('ct_clear_mm'), 0.0].max : 0.0

          @mc = s('mat_carcass'); @mb = s('mat_back'); @mf = s('mat_front'); @mff = s('mat_frame')
          @md = s('mat_drawer'); @mt = s('mat_top'); @mk = s('mat_kick')

          raise BuildError, "Height is too small: the box interior would be #{fmt(@top_under - @bottom_top)} mm." if @top_under - @bottom_top < 60
          raise BuildError, "Depth is too small: only #{fmt(@y_back_front - @cy0)} mm in front of the back panel." if @y_back_front - @cy0 < 60
          raise BuildError, 'Width is too small for two side panels.' if @cx1 - @cx0 < 2 * @t + 40
        end

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------ layout
        def layout_columns
          # NOOKS: one column the full width; the nooks fill it (nooks_layout)
          specs = @nooks ? [{ 'w' => 'auto', 'kind' => 'normal', 'rows' => [] }] : @p['columns']
          n = specs.size
          inner0 = @cx0 + @t
          inner1 = @cx1 - @t
          avail = inner1 - inner0 - (n - 1) * @t
          raise BuildError, "Module too narrow for #{n} columns." if avail < 40 * n
          widths = distribute(specs.map { |c| c['w'] }, avail, 'column widths')
          x = inner0
          @cols = []
          specs.each_with_index do |c, i|
            w = widths[i]
            @cols << { 'i' => i, 'x0' => x, 'x1' => x + w, 'kind' => c['kind'], 'rows' => c['rows'],
                       'first' => i.zero?, 'last' => i == n - 1, 'tag' => "C#{i + 1}" }
            x += w + @t
          end
          @cols.each_with_index do |c, i|
            c['cl'] = i.zero? ? nil : @cols[i - 1]['x1'] + @t / 2.0
            c['cr'] = i == n - 1 ? nil : c['x1'] + @t / 2.0
            c['knee'] = c['kind'] == 'kneehole'
          end
          # Segments = runs of normal columns (kneeholes split bottoms, backs and kicks).
          @segs = []
          @cols.each do |c|
            next if c['knee']
            if @segs.empty? || @segs.last['c1'] != c['i'] - 1
              @segs << { 'x0' => c['x0'], 'x1' => c['x1'], 'c0' => c['i'], 'c1' => c['i'] }
            else
              @segs.last['x1'] = c['x1']
              @segs.last['c1'] = c['i']
            end
          end
        end

        def layout_rows
          zlo = @ff ? @base_z : @bottom_under
          zhi = @top
          @cols.each do |c|
            next if c['knee']
            rows = c['rows']
            if rows.empty?
              c['hs'] = []
              c['slots'] = []
              next
            end
            hs = distribute(rows.map { |rw| rw['h'] }, zhi - zlo, "row heights in column #{c['i'] + 1}")
            c['hs'] = hs
            z1 = zhi
            c['slots'] = rows.each_with_index.map do |rw, j|
              z0 = j == rows.size - 1 ? zlo : z1 - hs[j]
              sl = { 'row' => rw, 'z0' => z0, 'z1' => z1, 'first' => j.zero?, 'last' => j == rows.size - 1,
                     'tag' => "#{c['tag']}R#{j + 1}" }
              sl['iz0'] = sl['last'] ? @bottom_top : z0 + (@divider ? @t / 2.0 : 0)
              sl['iz1'] = sl['first'] ? @top_under : z1 - (@divider ? @t / 2.0 : 0)
              z1 = z0
              sl
            end
          end
        end

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------ carcass
        # floor: the panel runs to the floor whatever the base (kneehole sides).
        # end_panel: a desk end beside a kneehole — no cabinet above, so no toe-kick notch.
        def upright(name, x0, x1, inner = false, floor = false, end_panel = false)
          z0 = if floor then 0.0
               elsif @sides_low
                 %w[integral none].include?(@kick) || (@dsides && @kick == 'plinth') ? 0.0 : @base_z
               else
                 @bottom_top
               end
          z1 = if inner then @top_under
               elsif @top_over && !@stretch then @top - @t
               else @side_top
               end
          y0 = @cy0
          y1 = @side_back
          notched = !end_panel && @sides_low && @kick == 'integral' && @kh > 0 && @notch > y0 + 0.5
          pts = if notched
                  [[y0, @kh], [@notch, @kh], [@notch, 0.0], [y1, 0.0], [y1, z1], [y0, z1]]
                else
                  [[y0, z0], [y1, z0], [y1, z1], [y0, z1]]
                end
          extra = notched ? { 'note' => "toe-kick notch #{fmt(@notch - y0)}×#{fmt @kh}" } : {}
          # A visible end (no decorative panel over it) takes the end-panel material.
          mat = @mc
          if (name == 'Side L' && @p['end_l'] && @sl <= 0) || (name == 'Side R' && @p['end_r'] && @sr <= 0)
            mat = s('mat_end')
            extra = extra.merge('note' => [extra['note'], 'visible end'].compact.join('; '))
          end
          prism(name, 'carcass', mat, 'x', x0, x1 - x0, pts, 'z', '1L 1W', extra)  # front edge + one end
        end

        def carcass
          # A side that closes a kneehole at the end of a desk stands on the floor.
          upright('Side L', @cx0, @cx0 + @t, false, @cols.first['knee'], @cols.first['knee'])
          upright('Side R', @cx1 - @t, @cx1, false, @cols.last['knee'], @cols.last['knee'])

          # Partitions between columns
          @cols.each_with_index do |c, i|
            next if c['last']
            nb = @cols[i + 1]
            px0 = c['x1']
            px1 = c['x1'] + @t
            if c['knee'] || nb['knee']
              upright('Pedestal side', px0, px1, true, @knee_all)
            else
              panel('Partition', 'carcass', @mc, px0, px1, @cy0, @y_back_front, @bottom_top, @top_under, 'x', 'z', '1L')
            end
          end

          # Bottom(s)
          if @sides_low
            @segs.each do |sg|
              panel('Bottom', 'carcass', @mc, sg['x0'], sg['x1'], @cy0, @y_tb_back, @bottom_under, @bottom_top, 'z', 'x', '1L')
            end
          else
            panel('Bottom', 'carcass', @mc, @cx0, @cx1, @cy0, @y_tb_back, @bottom_under, @bottom_top, 'z', 'x', '1L')
          end

          # Top / stretchers
          if @stretch
            sx0 = @cx0 + @t
            sx1 = @cx1 - @t
            fy = @cy0 + f('stretcher_setback')
            if @on_edge
              panel('Front stretcher', 'carcass', @mc, sx0, sx1, fy, fy + @t, @top - @drop - @sw, @top - @drop, 'y', 'x', '1L')
            else
              panel('Front stretcher', 'carcass', @mc, sx0, sx1, fy, fy + @sw, @top - @drop - @t, @top - @drop, 'z', 'x', '1L')
            end
            if @p['rear_stretcher']
              if @r_on_edge
                panel('Rear stretcher', 'carcass', @mc, sx0, sx1, @y_back_front - @t, @y_back_front, @top - @rsw, @top, 'y', 'x', '1L')
              else
                panel('Rear stretcher', 'carcass', @mc, sx0, sx1, @y_back_front - @rsw, @y_back_front, @top - @t, @top, 'z', 'x', '1L')
              end
            end
          else
            tx0, tx1 = @top_over ? [@cx0, @cx1] : [@cx0 + @t, @cx1 - @t]
            panel('Top', 'carcass', @mc, tx0, tx1, @cy0 + @top_set, @y_tb_back, @top - @t, @top, 'z', 'x', '1L',
                  @top_set > 0 ? { 'note' => "set back #{fmt @top_set} mm from the front" } : {})
          end

          # Back(s)
          multi = @segs.size > 1
          @segs.each_with_index do |sg, i|
            nm = multi ? "Back #{i + 1}" : 'Back'
            case @back
            when 'groove'
              ztop = @stretch ? @top : @top_under + @g
              gw = [f('back_groove_w'), @bt].min
              note = "slotted: #{fmt gw} wide × #{fmt @g} deep groove, #{fmt(@D - @y_back_rear)} mm from rear"
              note += "; rebate edges to #{fmt gw} mm tongue" if @bt > gw + 0.05
              panel(nm, 'back', @mb, sg['x0'] - @g, sg['x1'] + @g, @y_back_front, @y_back_rear,
                    @bottom_top - @g, ztop, 'y', 'z', '', 'note' => note)
            when 'inset'
              ztop = @stretch ? @top : @top_under
              panel(nm, 'back', @mb, sg['x0'], sg['x1'], @y_back_front, @y_back_rear, @bottom_top, ztop, 'y', 'z', '',
                    'note' => "not slotted: set in between panels, #{fmt(@D - @y_back_rear)} mm from rear")
            else
              if @sides_low
                ax0 = sg['x0'] - @t
                ax1 = sg['x1'] + @t
              else
                ax0 = @cx0
                ax1 = @cx1
              end
              zb, zt = applied_back_z
              note = ['applied to rear', @p['back_floor'] ? 'to the floor' : nil, zt > @side_top + 0.05 ? "#{fmt(zt - @side_top)} mm above the module" : nil].compact.join('; ')
              panel(nm, 'back', @mb, ax0, ax1, @y_back_front, @y_back_rear, zb, zt, 'y', 'z', '2L 2W', 'note' => note)  # applied: all edges show
            end
          end

          # Modesty panels in kneeholes
          mh = f('modesty_h')
          @cols.each do |c|
            next unless c['knee'] && mh > 0
            z0 = [@top_under - mh, @base_z].max
            panel('Modesty panel', 'carcass', @mc, c['x0'], c['x1'], @y_back_rear - @t, @y_back_rear, z0, @top_under, 'y', 'x', '1L')
          end
        end

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------ base
        def base
          return if @kick == 'none' || @kh <= 0
          @segs.each do |sg|
            if @sides_low
              # pedestal sides that run to the floor: the base fits between them
              x0 = sg['c0'] > 0 && @knee_all ? sg['x0'] : sg['x0'] - @t
              x1 = sg['c1'] < @cols.size - 1 && @knee_all ? sg['x1'] : sg['x1'] + @t
            else
              x0 = @cx0
              x1 = @cx1
            end
            ny = @notch
            # sides full height run to the floor: the plinth boards fit between them (no end rails)
            between = @dsides && @kick == 'plinth'
            if between
              x0 = sg['x0']
              x1 = sg['x1']
            end
            case @kick
            when 'integral'
              panel('Toe kick', 'base', @mk, x0, x1, ny - @t, ny, 0, @kh, 'y', 'x', '')
            when 'plinth'
              # its FRONT face sits the setback behind the carcass front (default 20 mm); the back board
              # is flush with the carcass back
              ny = f('kick_setback')
              panel('Plinth front', 'base', @mk, x0, x1, ny, ny + @t, 0, @kh, 'y', 'x', '')
              panel('Plinth back', 'base', @mk, x0, x1, @side_back - @t, @side_back, 0, @kh, 'y', 'x', '')
              span = x1 - x0
              n_int = [(span / 600.0).ceil - 1, 0].max
              xs = between ? [] : [x0]
              (1..n_int).each { |k| xs << x0 + span * k / (n_int + 1) - @t / 2.0 }
              xs << x1 - @t unless between
              xs.each do |px|
                panel('Plinth rail', 'base', @mk, px, px + @t, ny + @t, @side_back - @t, 0, @kh, 'x', 'y', '')
              end
            when 'legs'
              # The clip-on toe kick for legs is bought by length, not cut from board: it is
              # neither drawn nor in the cut list — only in hardware and the 4 m bar plan.
              hw("Plastic toe kick, stainless look, #{fmt @kh} mm high: #{fmt x1 - x0} mm", 1)
              unless Params::KICK_PLASTIC_H.any? { |h| (h - @kh).abs < 0.05 }
                warn("The plastic toe kick comes 100 or 150 mm high — set the toe kick height to one of them (now #{fmt @kh} mm).")
              end
              span = x1 - x0
              n_x = [(span / 900.0).ceil + 1, 2].max
              xs = (0...n_x).map { |k| x0 + 40 + (span - 80) * k / (n_x - 1) }
              ys = [ny + 40, @side_back - 40]
              xs.each do |lx|
                ys.each { |ly| cyl('Adjustable leg', Params::METAL, [lx, ly, 0], 'z', 15, @kh) }
              end
              hw("Adjustable leg, #{fmt @kh} mm", xs.size * ys.size)
              hw('Toe-kick clip', [xs.size, 2].max)
            end
          end
        end

        # Decorative top, laid on the carcass (outside the module height). With decorative
        # side panels it either covers them (side overhang measured from their outer face)
        # or sits nested between them.
        def worktop
          return unless @add_top
          oh_s = f('top_oh_sides')
          between = s('top_skin_mode') == 'between'
          x0 = @sl > 0 ? (between ? 0.0 : -@sl - oh_s) : -oh_s
          x1 = @sr > 0 ? (between ? @W : @W + @sr + oh_s) : @W + oh_s
          panel('Top (solid)', 'top', @mt, x0, x1, -f('top_oh_front'), @D + f('top_oh_back'), @H, @H + @top_t, 'z', 'x', '2L 2W')
        end

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------ stone top (look only)
        # On the module's top (over a decorative top if there is one), from the decorative sides'
        # outer faces and the fronts' (or the carcass') front face, plus the overhangs. A 2 cm slab
        # gets a lightly eased front edge, a 4 cm one a double bullnose (fully rounded). Not cut:
        # it is listed for the stone supplier.
        def stone_top
          return unless @p['stone']
          st = f('stone_t')
          front = @parts.select { |pt| %w[front frame].include?(pt['role']) && pt['shape'] == 'prism' }.map { |pt| part_ymin(pt) }.min
          yf = s('stone_ref') == 'carcass' || front.nil? ? 0.0 : [front, 0.0].min
          y0 = yf - f('stone_oh_front')
          y1 = @D + f('stone_oh_back')
          x0 = -@sl - f('stone_oh_left')
          x1 = @W + @sr + f('stone_oh_right')
          z0 = @H + @top_t
          prof = Run.stone_profile(y0, y1, z0, st, st >= 30 ? 'bullnose' : 'eased')
          prism('Stone top', 'hardware', Params::STONE_LOOKS[s('stone_look')], 'x', x0, x1 - x0, prof, 'y', '', 'cut' => false)
          look = STONE_LOOK_NAMES[s('stone_look')]
          hw("Stone top (by others), #{look}, #{fmt x1 - x0} × #{fmt y1 - y0} × #{fmt st} mm#{st >= 30 ? ', double bullnose' : ''}", 1)
        end

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------ crown (Params.crown_norm)
        # Strips on edge on top of the module, on the sides chosen. The front strip runs the full
        # width, the side strips between the front and back ones, the back strip between the sides.
        def crown
          return unless @p['crown']
          sides = s('crown_sides')
          t = f('crown_t')
          h = f('crown_h')
          pos = s('crown_pos')
          back_in = pos == 'recessed' ? f('crown_setback') : 0.0
          front = @parts.select { |pt| %w[front frame].include?(pt['role']) && pt['shape'] == 'prism' }.map { |pt| part_ymin(pt) }.min
          yf = case pos
               when 'fronts' then front ? [front, 0.0].min : 0.0
               when 'recessed' then back_in
               else 0.0
               end
          xl = -@sl + back_in
          xr = @W + @sr - back_in
          yb = @D - back_in
          z0 = @H + @top_t
          f_on = sides.include?('F')
          b_on = sides.include?('B')
          l_on = sides.include?('L')
          r_on = sides.include?('R')
          mat = @mt
          eb = '1L'   # the top edge
          panel('Crown front', 'skin', mat, xl, xr, yf, yf + t, z0, z0 + h, 'y', 'x', eb) if f_on
          ys0 = f_on ? yf + t : yf
          ys1 = b_on ? yb - t : yb
          panel('Crown side L', 'skin', mat, xl, xl + t, ys0, ys1, z0, z0 + h, 'x', 'y', eb) if l_on
          panel('Crown side R', 'skin', mat, xr - t, xr, ys0, ys1, z0, z0 + h, 'x', 'y', eb) if r_on
          panel('Crown back', 'skin', mat, l_on ? xl + t : xl, r_on ? xr - t : xr, yb - t, yb, z0, z0 + h, 'y', 'x', eb) if b_on
        end

        STONE_LOOK_NAMES = { 'marble_white' => 'white marble', 'granite_grey' => 'grey granite', 'granite_black' => 'black granite' }.freeze

        # Profile (y, z) of a stone top from y0 (front) to y1, z0 up st: the front edge eased
        # (4 mm round top and bottom), a double bullnose (a half round) or square ('none').
        def self.stone_profile(y0, y1, z0, st, edge)
          return [[y0, z0], [y1, z0], [y1, z0 + st], [y0, z0 + st]] if edge == 'none'
          rad = edge == 'bullnose' ? st / 2.0 : [4.0, st / 2.0].min
          prof = [[y1, z0], [y1, z0 + st]]
          i = 0
          while i < 6
            a = Math::PI / 2 * (1 - i / 5.0)
            prof << [y0 + rad - rad * Math.cos(a), z0 + st - rad + rad * Math.sin(a)]
            i += 1
          end
          i = 0
          while i < 6
            a = Math::PI / 2 * (i / 5.0)
            prof << [y0 + rad - rad * Math.cos(a), z0 + rad - rad * Math.sin(a)]
            i += 1
          end
          prof.uniq
        end

        # A loose stone piece (Params.slab_norm): a top slab, a backsplash or a trim, look only.
        # Its box is 0..width × 0..depth × 0..height; a top's front edge is at y = 0.
        SLAB_NAMES = { 'top' => 'Stone top', 'splash' => 'Stone backsplash', 'trim' => 'Stone trim' }.freeze
        def build_slab
          kind = s('slab_kind')
          st = f('stone_t')
          w = f('width'); d = f('depth'); h = f('height')
          mat = Params::STONE_LOOKS[s('stone_look')]
          name = SLAB_NAMES[kind]
          if kind == 'top'
            prism(name, 'hardware', mat, 'x', 0.0, w, Run.stone_profile(0.0, d, 0.0, st, s('slab_edge')), 'y', '', 'cut' => false)
          else
            prism(name, 'hardware', mat, 'x', 0.0, w, [[0.0, 0.0], [d, 0.0], [d, h], [0.0, h]], 'y', '', 'cut' => false)
          end
          ends = s('slab_ends').chars.map { |c| c == 'L' ? 'left' : 'right' }
          size = kind == 'top' ? [f('slab_l'), f('slab_w'), st] : [f('slab_l'), f('slab_w'), st]
          extra = kind == 'top' && st >= 30 ? ', double bullnose' : ''
          extra += ", finished #{ends.join(' + ')} end#{ends.size > 1 ? 's' : ''}" unless ends.empty?
          hw("#{name} (by others), #{STONE_LOOK_NAMES[s('stone_look')]}, #{size.map { |v| fmt v }.join(' × ')} mm#{extra}", 1)
          assign_pids
          { 'parts' => @parts, 'warnings' => @warnings, 'hardware' => @hw.to_a, 'movers' => @movers,
            'corner' => nil, 'layout' => [], 'bbox' => bbox, 'params' => @p }
        end

        # The lowest y (furthest to the front) of a part.
        def part_ymin(pt)
          return pt['pos'] if pt['axis'] == 'y'
          u, v = plane_axes(pt['axis'])
          vals = pt['pts'].map { |q| u == 'y' ? q[0] : q[1] }
          v == 'y' || u == 'y' ? vals.min : 0.0
        end

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------ decorative side panels
        def skins
          back_skin
          return if @sl <= 0 && @sr <= 0
          y0 = @p['skin_front_flush'] ? (@inset ? 0.0 : -@ft) : -f('skin_front')
          y1 = @D + f('skin_back')
          z0, z1 = skin_z
          floor = z0 <= 0.05
          eb = floor ? '1L 2W' : '1L 1W' # front edge + top edge (+ floor edge)
          note = floor ? 'decorative; banded front, top and floor edges' : 'decorative; banded front and top edges'
          ms = s('mat_skin')
          { 'L' => [-@sl, 0.0, @sl], 'R' => [@W, @W + @sr, @sr] }.each do |side, (a, b, th)|
            next if th <= 0
            prism("Decorative side #{side}", 'skin', ms, 'x', a, b - a,
                  [[y0, z0], [y1, z0], [y1, z1], [y0, z1]], 'z', eb, 'note' => note)
          end
        end

        # Decorative back (a back that is seen, e.g. an island): behind the carcass — behind the
        # rear edge of the decorative side panels when there are any — across the whole width,
        # same height as the side panels. Outside the module depth, like the decorative top.
        def back_skin
          return unless @p['skin_b']
          th = f('skin_t')
          return if th <= 0
          y = @D + (@sl > 0 || @sr > 0 ? f('skin_back') : 0.0)
          z0, z1 = skin_z
          floor = z0 <= 0.05
          both = @sl > 0 && @sr > 0
          eb = [floor ? '2L' : '1L', both ? nil : (@sl > 0 || @sr > 0 ? '1W' : '2W')].compact.join(' ')
          note = 'decorative back' + (floor ? '; to the floor' : '')
          panel('Decorative back', 'skin', s('mat_skin'), -@sl, @W + @sr, y, y + th, z0, z1, 'y', 'x', eb, 'note' => note)
        end

        # Top, bottom and back that are seen (an island, a wall cabinet from below, an open back)
        # take the visible-end material, like visible sides — unless a decorative panel covers them.
        def visible_faces
          vis = { 'Top' => @p['end_top'] && !@add_top, 'Bottom' => @p['end_bottom'], 'Back' => @p['end_back'] && !@p['skin_b'] }
          return unless vis.values.any?
          me = s('mat_end')
          @parts.each do |pt|
            key = pt['name'] =~ /\ABack( \d+)?\z/ && pt['role'] == 'back' ? 'Back' : pt['name']
            next unless pt['role'] != 'skin' && vis[key]
            pt['mat'] = me
            pt['note'] = [pt['note'], 'visible'].compact.join('; ')
          end
        end

        # Applied back: from the carcass bottom (or the floor) up to the carcass top, or to a
        # height of its own — kept within the module height unless it may go past it.
        def applied_back_z
          zb = @p['back_floor'] ? 0.0 : @bottom_under
          zt = @side_top
          if @p['back_hset'] && f('back_h') > 0
            zt = zb + f('back_h')
            if zt > @side_top + 0.05 && !@p['back_over']
              warn("The back is #{fmt f('back_h')} mm high — only #{fmt(@side_top - zb)} mm fit within the module height; tick “may go past the module height” to keep it.")
              zt = @side_top
            end
          end
          [zb, zt]
        end

        # Bottom and top of the decorative side / back panels.
        def skin_z
          base = if @sides_low
                   %w[integral none].include?(@kick) ? 0.0 : @base_z
                 else
                   @bottom_under
                 end
          z0 = @p['skin_floor'] ? 0.0 : [base - f('skin_bottom'), 0.0].max
          between = s('top_skin_mode') == 'between'
          z1 = if @add_top && !between then @H
               elsif @add_top then @H + @top_t + (@p['skin_top_flush'] ? 0.0 : f('skin_top'))
               else @H + f('skin_top')
               end
          [z0, z1]
        end

        # Move everything right by dx (decorative panels inside the module width).
        def shift_x(dx)
          @parts.each do |pt|
            if pt['shape'] == 'cyl'
              pt['center'][0] = r(pt['center'][0] + dx)
            elsif pt['axis'] == 'x'
              pt['pos'] = r(pt['pos'] + dx)
            else
              pt['pts'] = pt['pts'].map { |q| [r(q[0] + dx), q[1]] }
            end
            (pt['grooves'] || []).each { |ln| ln.each { |q| q[0] = r(q[0] + dx) } }
            pt['slide']['face_x'] = r(pt['slide']['face_x'] + dx) if pt['slide'] # slide model placement
            if pt['hinge']                                                        # hinge model placement
              pt['hinge']['x'] = r(pt['hinge']['x'] + dx)
              pt['hinge']['side_x'] = r(pt['hinge']['side_x'] + dx) if pt['hinge']['side_x']
            end
          end
          @movers.each do |m|
            m['pivot'][0] = r(m['pivot'][0] + dx) if m['pivot']
            m['at'][0] = r(m['at'][0] + dx) if m['at']
          end
        end

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------ blind corner
        # Seen from the front, from the outer edge on the blind side:
        #   blind panel — covers the module on the other wall (its depth + its front) plus the
        #                 clearance, or a width you give, or whatever a given door width leaves
        #   door(s)     — the opening; the door overlays a hinge divider like a side panel
        # The hinge divider stands behind the door edge, perpendicular to the front.
        # The clearance strip stands perpendicular to the blind panel at the other module's
        # carcass edge (behind its doors): that module butts against it and is held away by
        # the strip's width, so doors and handles don't clash in the corner.
        def setup_corner
          @cn = nil
          side = s('corner')
          return if side == 'none'
          if @ff
            warn('Blind corners are built for frameless cabinets — with a face frame use a wide stile instead.')
            return
          end
          col = side == 'left' ? @cols.first : @cols.last
          return if col.nil? || col['knee']
          left = side == 'left'
          m = ->(x) { left ? x : @W - x }               # "distance from the blind edge" → module x
          nb = f('corner_nb_depth')
          clear = [f('corner_clear'), 0.0].max
          # far door edge of this column, measured from the blind edge
          a = col['first'] ? 0.0 : col['cl']
          b = col['last'] ? @W : col['cr']
          far = left ? front_edge(b, col['last'], -1, :x, @t, true) : @W - front_edge(a, col['first'], 1, :x, @t, true)
          door_from_edge = case s('corner_size')
                           when 'blind' then f('corner_blind_w') + @gap / 2.0
                           when 'door' then far - f('corner_door_w')
                           else nb + @ft + clear + @gap / 2.0
                           end
          blind_end = door_from_edge - @gap / 2.0
          over = front_edge(0.0, true, 1, :x, @t, true) # a door edge's distance from a side's outer face
          dx0 = door_from_edge - over                   # divider face on the blind side
          dx1 = dx0 + @t
          inner = left ? col['x0'] : @W - col['x1']
          if dx0 < inner + 20
            warn("Blind corner: the blind section (#{fmt blind_end} mm) is too narrow for a hinge divider.")
            return
          end
          opening = far - door_from_edge
          raise BuildError, "Blind corner: the door would be only #{fmt opening} mm wide (blind section #{fmt blind_end} mm) — widen the module or narrow the blind side." if opening < 150
          if clear > 0 && nb > blind_end - 1
            warn("Blind corner: the module on the other wall (#{fmt nb} mm deep) reaches past the blind panel (#{fmt blind_end} mm) — widen the blind side.")
          end
          @cn = {
            'side' => side, 'col' => col, 'clear' => clear, 'nb' => nb,
            'door_x' => m.(door_from_edge), 'blind_x' => [m.(0.0), m.(blind_end)].sort,
            'strip_x' => [m.(nb - @t), m.(nb)].sort,
            'div_x0' => [m.(dx0), m.(dx1)].min, 'div_x1' => [m.(dx0), m.(dx1)].max,
            'div_y0' => @y_int_front, 'div_y1' => @y_int_front + f('corner_div_w'),
            'opening' => opening, 'blind_w' => blind_end
          }
          if left then col['hx0'] = @cn['div_x1']
          else col['hx1'] = @cn['div_x0']
          end
        end

        def corner_parts
          return unless @cn
          c = @cn['col']
          slots = c['slots']
          z0 = front_edge(slots.last['z0'], true, 1, :z, @t, @divider)
          z1 = front_edge(slots.first['z1'], true, -1, :z, @top_edge, @divider) - @ct_drop
          y0, y1 = @inset ? [0.0, @ft] : [-@ft, 0.0]
          bx0, bx1 = @cn['blind_x']
          if @cn['side'] == 'left' then bx0 = front_edge(0.0, true, 1, :x, @t, true)
          else bx1 = front_edge(@W, true, -1, :x, @t, true)
          end
          panel('Blind panel', 'front', s('mat_front'), bx0, bx1, y0, y1, z0, z1, 'y', 'z', '2L 2W',
                'note' => "fixed; the module on the other wall (#{fmt @cn['nb']} mm deep) stands in front of it")
          if @cn['clear'] >= 1
            sx0, sx1 = @cn['strip_x']
            face = @inset ? 0.0 : -@ft
            panel('Corner filler', 'front', s('mat_front'), sx0, sx1, face - @cn['clear'], face, z0, z1, 'x', 'z', '2L 1W',
                  'note' => "perpendicular to the blind panel at the other module's carcass edge; holds it #{fmt @cn['clear']} mm away")
            # a second one at the outer (wall) edge, so the other module rests on two points
            ox0, ox1 = @cn['side'] == 'left' ? [0.0, @t] : [@W - @t, @W]
            panel('Corner filler', 'front', s('mat_front'), ox0, ox1, face - @cn['clear'], face, z0, z1, 'x', 'z', '2L 1W',
                  'note' => "perpendicular to the blind panel at the outer edge; second contact for the other module (#{fmt @cn['clear']} mm)")
          end
          panel('Hinge divider', 'carcass', @mc, @cn['div_x0'], @cn['div_x1'], @cn['div_y0'], @cn['div_y1'],
                @bottom_top, @top_under, 'x', 'z', '2L', 'note' => 'hinges screw onto it; fixed to bottom and top')
          hw('Connector bracket for blind panel and fillers', @cn['clear'] >= 1 ? 3 : 2)
        end

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------ face frame
        def ff_open_x(c)
          a = c['first'] ? 0.0 : c['cl']
          b = c['last'] ? @W : c['cr']
          [a + (c['first'] ? @st : @mid / 2.0), b - (c['last'] ? @st : @mid / 2.0)]
        end

        def ff_open_z(sl)
          [sl['z0'] + (sl['last'] ? @rail : @mid / 2.0), sl['z1'] - (sl['first'] ? @rail : @mid / 2.0)]
        end

        def face_frame
          fz0 = @base_z
          fz1 = @top
          panel('FF stile', 'frame', @mff, 0, @st, 0, @fft, fz0, fz1, 'y', 'z')
          panel('FF stile', 'frame', @mff, @W - @st, @W, 0, @fft, fz0, fz1, 'y', 'z')
          panel('FF top rail', 'frame', @mff, @st, @W - @st, 0, @fft, fz1 - @rail, fz1, 'y', 'x')
          @segs.each do |sg|
            c0 = @cols[sg['c0']]
            c1 = @cols[sg['c1']]
            bx0 = c0['first'] ? @st : c0['cl'] + @mid / 2.0
            bx1 = c1['last'] ? @W - @st : c1['cr'] - @mid / 2.0
            panel('FF bottom rail', 'frame', @mff, bx0, bx1, 0, @fft, fz0, fz0 + @rail, 'y', 'x')
          end
          @cols.each_with_index do |c, i|
            next if c['last']
            cc = c['cr']
            knee_adj = c['knee'] || @cols[i + 1]['knee']
            z0 = knee_adj ? fz0 : fz0 + @rail
            panel('FF mid stile', 'frame', @mff, cc - @mid / 2.0, cc + @mid / 2.0, 0, @fft, z0, fz1 - @rail, 'y', 'z')
          end
          if @cols.any? { |c| !c['knee'] && (c['first'] && @st > @cx0 + @t + 0.5 || c['last'] && @st > @W - @cx1 + @t + 0.5) }
            @stile_proud = true
          end
          @cols.each do |c|
            next if c['knee']
            ox0, ox1 = ff_open_x(c)
            c['slots'].each do |sl|
              next if sl['last']
              seam = sl['z0']
              panel('FF mid rail', 'frame', @mff, ox0, ox1, 0, @fft, seam - @mid / 2.0, seam + @mid / 2.0, 'y', 'x')
            end
          end
        end

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------ fronts
        # Position of a front edge. dir = +1 for a low edge, -1 for a high edge.
        def front_edge(boundary, outer, dir, axis, edge_thk, has_divider)
          if @ff
            open = boundary + dir * (outer ? (axis == :x ? @st : @rail) : @mid / 2.0)
            return @inset ? open + dir * @ffg : open - dir * @ffo
          end
          case @overlay
          when 'inset'
            if outer then boundary + dir * (edge_thk + @gap)
            elsif has_divider then boundary + dir * (@t / 2.0 + @gap)
            else boundary + dir * @gap / 2.0
            end
          when 'half'
            outer ? boundary + dir * (edge_thk / 2.0 + @gap / 2.0) : boundary + dir * @gap / 2.0
          else
            outer ? boundary + dir * @rev : boundary + dir * @gap / 2.0
          end
        end

        def front_rect(c, sl)
          a = c['first'] ? 0.0 : c['cl']
          b = c['last'] ? @W : c['cr']
          x0 = front_edge(a, c['first'], 1, :x, @t, true)
          x1 = front_edge(b, c['last'], -1, :x, @t, true)
          if @cn && c.equal?(@cn['col'])
            # blind corner: the fronts start past the blind panel and the clearance strip
            if @cn['side'] == 'left' then x0 = @cn['door_x']
            else x1 = @cn['door_x']
            end
          end
          z0 = front_edge(sl['z0'], sl['last'], 1, :z, @t, sl.fetch('div_lo', @divider))
          z1 = front_edge(sl['z1'], sl['first'], -1, :z, @top_edge, sl.fetch('div_hi', @divider))
          # sides past the top: the top fronts go up to the top of the sides — inset ones only when
          # the top stands back far enough to leave them room in front of it
          if sl['first'] && !@ff && @side_top > @top + 0.05 && (!@inset || @top_set >= @ft - 0.05)
            z1 = @side_top - (@inset ? @gap : @rev)
          elsif sl['first'] && !@ff && @inset && @top_set >= @ft - 0.05
            z1 = @side_top - @gap
          end
          z1 -= @ct_drop if sl['first'] # clearance under a dropped countertop edge (e.g. double bullnose)
          [x0, x1, z0, z1]
        end

        def hinge_name
          if @ff
            @inset ? 'Concealed hinge, soft-close, face-frame inset' : 'Concealed hinge, soft-close, face-frame overlay'
          else
            case @overlay
            when 'inset' then 'Concealed hinge 110°, soft-close, inset arm (e.g. Blum CLIP top BLUMOTION)'
            when 'half' then 'Concealed hinge 110°, soft-close, half-overlay arm (e.g. Blum CLIP top BLUMOTION)'
            else 'Concealed hinge 110°, soft-close, full-overlay arm (e.g. Blum CLIP top BLUMOTION)'
            end
          end
        end

        def hinge_count(h)
          if h <= 900 then 2
          elsif h <= 1600 then 3
          elsif h <= 2000 then 4
          else 5
          end
        end

        def make_front(base, kind, x0, x1, z0, z1, tag, extra = {})
          w = x1 - x0
          h = z1 - z0
          if w < 40 || h < 40
            warn("#{tag}: #{base.downcase} is too small (#{fmt w}×#{fmt h} mm) — check sizes and gaps.")
            return
          end
          return glass_front(x0, x1, z0, z1, tag, extra) if @glass && kind == :door
          y0, y1 = @inset ? [0.0, @ft] : [-@ft, 0.0]
          grain = kind == :drawer ? 'x' : 'z'
          extra = extra.merge('tag' => tag)
          case s('front_style')
          when 'shaker'
            sw = f('shaker_w')
            if w > 2 * sw + 40 && h > 2 * sw + 40
              pt = f('shaker_panel_t')
              panel("#{base} stile", 'front', @mf, x0, x0 + sw, y0, y1, z0, z1, 'y', 'z', '', extra)
              panel("#{base} stile", 'front', @mf, x1 - sw, x1, y0, y1, z0, z1, 'y', 'z', '', extra)
              panel("#{base} rail", 'front', @mf, x0 + sw, x1 - sw, y0, y1, z0, z0 + sw, 'y', 'x', '', extra)
              panel("#{base} rail", 'front', @mf, x0 + sw, x1 - sw, y0, y1, z1 - sw, z1, 'y', 'x', '', extra)
              panel("#{base} panel", 'front', @mf, x0 + sw - 8, x1 - sw + 8, y1 - 4 - pt, y1 - 4, z0 + sw - 8, z1 - sw + 8,
                    'y', grain, '', extra.merge('note' => 'includes 8 mm tongue each side'))
              return
            end
            panel(base, 'front', @mf, x0, x1, y0, y1, z0, z1, 'y', grain, '2L 2W', extra.merge('note' => 'slab — too small for shaker'))
          when 'plank'
            vertical = s('plank_dir') == 'vertical'
            span = vertical ? w : h
            pg = f('plank_gap')
            n = [(span / f('plank_w')).round, 1].max
            pw = (span - (n - 1) * pg) / n
            (0...n).each do |k|
              a = (vertical ? x0 : z0) + k * (pw + pg)
              if vertical
                panel("#{base} plank", 'front', @mf, a, a + pw, y0, y1, z0, z1, 'y', 'z', '2L 2W', extra)
              else
                panel("#{base} plank", 'front', @mf, x0, x1, y0, y1, a, a + pw, 'y', 'x', '2L 2W', extra)
              end
            end
          when 'grooved'
            vertical = s('plank_dir') == 'vertical'
            span = vertical ? w : h
            n = [(span / f('plank_w')).round, 1].max
            grooves = (1...n).map do |k|
              q = (vertical ? x0 : z0) + span * k / n
              vertical ? [[r(q), r(z0)], [r(q), r(z1)]] : [[r(x0), r(q)], [r(x1), r(q)]]
            end
            panel(base, 'front', @mf, x0, x1, y0, y1, z0, z1, 'y', grain, '2L 2W',
                  extra.merge('grooves' => grooves, 'note' => "#{n - 1} decorative V-grooves"))
          else
            panel(base, 'front', @mf, x0, x1, y0, y1, z0, z1, 'y', grain, '2L 2W', extra)
          end
        end

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------ pulls
        PULL_MATS = { 'black' => 'PanelPro Pull Black', 'stainless' => 'PanelPro Pull Stainless',
                      'aluminium' => 'PanelPro Pull Aluminium', 'gold' => 'PanelPro Pull Gold' }.freeze

        # A front plus its pull. who: :door / :drawer (which pull settings); hinge: 'L' / 'R'
        # for side-hung doors (corners are named from the hinge), nil for drawers and flaps.
        # A full-length profile takes its height off the panel, so panel + profile = the front.
        def front_with_pull(who, base, kind, x0, x1, z0, z1, tag, extra, hinge)
          type = s("#{who}_pull")
          if type == 'none' || x1 - x0 < 60 || z1 - z0 < 60
            make_front(base, kind, x0, x1, z0, z1, tag, extra)
            return
          end
          corner = s("#{who}_pull_corner")
          meeting = who == :door && hinge && @pull_v && corner != 'center'
          if meeting
            # keep hinge side / opening side as chosen, put it at the end facing the joint
            hinge_side = %w[A C].include?(corner)
            corner = @pull_v == :top ? (hinge_side ? 'A' : 'B') : (hinge_side ? 'C' : 'D')
          end
          ref = pull_corner(corner, x0, x1, z0, z1, hinge)
          edge = corner == 'center' ? 'h' : (meeting && type == 'wedge' ? 'v' : s("#{who}_pull_edge"))
          mv = extra['mover'] ? { 'mover' => extra['mover'] } : {}
          mat = PULL_MATS[s('pull_finish')] || PULL_MATS['black']
          fin = s('pull_finish')
          yf = @inset ? 0.0 : -@ft # the front's face
          yb = yf + @ft
          if type == 'profile'
            h = [f('profile_h'), 5.0].max
            px0, px1, pz0, pz1 = x0, x1, z0, z1
            side = if edge == 'h' then ref[:top] ? :top : :bottom
                   else ref[:left] ? :left : :right
                   end
            case side
            when :top then pz1 -= h
            when :bottom then pz0 += h
            when :left then px0 += h
            else px1 -= h
            end
            if px1 - px0 < 40 || pz1 - pz0 < 40
              warn("#{tag}: the #{fmt h} mm pull profile leaves too little front.")
              make_front(base, kind, x0, x1, z0, z1, tag, extra)
              return
            end
            make_front(base, kind, px0, px1, pz0, pz1, tag,
                       extra.merge('note' => [extra['note'], "+ #{fmt h} mm #{side} pull profile"].compact.join('; ')))
            pull_profile(side, x0, x1, z0, z1, h, yf, yb, mat, mv)
            len = %i[top bottom].include?(side) ? x1 - x0 : z1 - z0
            hw("Pull profile #{fmt h} mm, #{fin}, #{fmt len} mm long", 1)
            return
          end
          make_front(base, kind, x0, x1, z0, z1, tag, extra)
          if type == 'tbar'
            pull_tbar(who, ref, corner, x0, x1, z0, z1, yf, mat, mv, tag)
            hw("T-bar pull Ø#{fmt f('tbar_d')}, #{fmt f('tbar_cc')} mm centres, #{fmt f('tbar_len')} mm, #{fin}", 1)
          else
            pull_wedge(who, ref, corner, edge, x0, x1, z0, z1, yf, mat, mv, tag)
            hw("Edge (wedge) pull #{fmt f('wedge_len')} mm, #{fin}", 1)
          end
        end

        # The corner's position and which way "into the front" is from it.
        def pull_corner(corner, x0, x1, z0, z1, hinge)
          return { x: (x0 + x1) / 2.0, z: z1, sx: 1, sz: -1, top: true, left: false, center: true } if corner == 'center'
          tl = { 'A' => [true, true], 'B' => [true, false], 'C' => [false, true], 'D' => [false, false] }[corner]
          top, hinge_side = tl
          # door: A/C on the hinge side; drawers and flaps: A/C on the left
          left = hinge == 'R' ? !hinge_side : hinge_side
          { x: left ? x0 : x1, z: top ? z1 : z0, sx: left ? 1 : -1, sz: top ? -1 : 1, top: top, left: left, center: false }
        end

        def pull_tbar(who, ref, corner, x0, x1, z0, z1, yf, mat, mv, tag)
          rad = f('tbar_d') / 2.0
          len = f('tbar_len')
          off = [f('tbar_off'), f('tbar_d') + 5].max
          yc = yf - off + rad            # bar axis, in front of the face
          orient = corner == 'center' ? 'h' : s("#{who}_pull_orient")
          gx = f("#{who}_pull_gx")
          gy = f("#{who}_pull_gy")
          if orient == 'v'
            cx = corner == 'center' ? (x0 + x1) / 2.0 : ref[:x] + ref[:sx] * (gx + rad)
            za = corner == 'center' ? (z0 + z1 - len) / 2.0 : [ref[:z] + ref[:sz] * gy, ref[:z] + ref[:sz] * (gy + len)].min
            cyl('T-bar pull', mat, [cx, yc, za], 'z', rad, len, mv)
            mid = za + len / 2.0
            [mid - f('tbar_cc') / 2.0, mid + f('tbar_cc') / 2.0].each { |zp| cyl('T-bar post', mat, [cx, yc, zp], 'y', rad * 0.7, yf - yc, mv) }
            warn("#{tag}: the T-bar (#{fmt len} mm) is longer than the front.") if len > z1 - z0 - 10
          else
            cz = corner == 'center' ? (z0 + z1) / 2.0 : ref[:z] + ref[:sz] * (gy + rad)
            xa = corner == 'center' ? (x0 + x1 - len) / 2.0 : [ref[:x] + ref[:sx] * gx, ref[:x] + ref[:sx] * (gx + len)].min
            cyl('T-bar pull', mat, [xa, yc, cz], 'x', rad, len, mv)
            mid = xa + len / 2.0
            [mid - f('tbar_cc') / 2.0, mid + f('tbar_cc') / 2.0].each { |xp| cyl('T-bar post', mat, [xp, yc, cz], 'y', rad * 0.7, yf - yc, mv) }
            warn("#{tag}: the T-bar (#{fmt len} mm) is wider than the front.") if len > x1 - x0 - 10
          end
        end

        # L-shaped pull on an edge: a plate on the edge and a lip down over the face.
        # Wedge / edge pull: a flange screwed to the BACK face of the front (lip), and a plate
        # over the edge that runs forward past the front face (dep from the back, + t).
        def pull_wedge(who, ref, corner, edge, x0, x1, z0, z1, yf, mat, mv, tag)
          len = f('wedge_len')
          dep = [f('wedge_depth'), 5.0].max
          lip = [f('wedge_lip'), 0.0].max
          gap = f("#{who}_pull_gap")
          t = 2.0
          yb = yf + @ft                 # back face of the front
          e0 = yb + t - dep             # plate: from the front (proud of the face) …
          e1 = yb + t                   # … to just behind the back face
          extra = mv.merge('cut' => false)
          if edge == 'h'
            a = ref[:center] ? (x0 + x1 - len) / 2.0 : [ref[:x] + ref[:sx] * gap, ref[:x] + ref[:sx] * (gap + len)].min
            b = a + len
            warn("#{tag}: the edge pull (#{fmt len} mm) is longer than the front.") if len > x1 - x0
            if ref[:top]
              panel('Edge pull', 'hardware', mat, a, b, e0, e1, z1, z1 + t, 'z', 'x', '', extra)
              panel('Edge pull lip', 'hardware', mat, a, b, yb, yb + t, z1 - lip, z1, 'y', 'x', '', extra) if lip > 0.5
            else
              panel('Edge pull', 'hardware', mat, a, b, e0, e1, z0 - t, z0, 'z', 'x', '', extra)
              panel('Edge pull lip', 'hardware', mat, a, b, yb, yb + t, z0, z0 + lip, 'y', 'x', '', extra) if lip > 0.5
            end
          else
            a = [ref[:z] + ref[:sz] * gap, ref[:z] + ref[:sz] * (gap + len)].min
            b = a + len
            warn("#{tag}: the edge pull (#{fmt len} mm) is longer than the front.") if len > z1 - z0
            if ref[:left]
              panel('Edge pull', 'hardware', mat, x0 - t, x0, e0, e1, a, b, 'x', 'z', '', extra)
              panel('Edge pull lip', 'hardware', mat, x0, x0 + lip, yb, yb + t, a, b, 'y', 'z', '', extra) if lip > 0.5
            else
              panel('Edge pull', 'hardware', mat, x1, x1 + t, e0, e1, a, b, 'x', 'z', '', extra)
              panel('Edge pull lip', 'hardware', mat, x1 - lip, x1, yb, yb + t, a, b, 'y', 'z', '', extra) if lip > 0.5
            end
          end
        end

        # Black aluminium frame + glass, for the picture only (cut: false; listed in the hardware).
        # Outer 8 mm of the profile at full depth, the rest of its 45 mm face set back by the
        # glass thickness; the glass lies in that rebate, flush with the frame face.
        def glass_front(x0, x1, z0, z1, tag, extra)
          pw = Params::GLASS_PROFILE_W
          b = Params::GLASS_BORDER
          gt = Params::GLASS_T
          w = x1 - x0
          h = z1 - z0
          if w < 2 * pw + 20 || h < 2 * pw + 20
            warn("#{tag}: glass door is too small for the #{fmt pw} mm aluminium frame (#{fmt w}×#{fmt h} mm).")
          end
          y0, y1 = @inset ? [0.0, @ft] : [-@ft, 0.0]
          # 'glass_door': drawn in SketchUp as one "Glass door" component holding a frame
          # component and a glass component (see Geometry.draw_glass_doors)
          fx = extra.merge('tag' => tag, 'cut' => false, 'glass_door' => "#{fmt w}x#{fmt h}")
          fx.delete('note')
          al = Params::ALU_MAT
          name = 'Glass door frame'
          # four bars mitred at 45° in the corners (trapezoids seen from the front); each bar
          # in two strips: the outer 8 mm at full depth, the rest set back by the glass
          # each: [outer start, outer end, inner end, inner start]
          bars = {
            'bottom' => [[x0, z0], [x1, z0], [x1 - pw, z0 + pw], [x0 + pw, z0 + pw]],
            'top' => [[x0, z1], [x1, z1], [x1 - pw, z1 - pw], [x0 + pw, z1 - pw]],
            'left' => [[x0, z0], [x0, z1], [x0 + pw, z1 - pw], [x0 + pw, z0 + pw]],
            'right' => [[x1, z0], [x1, z1], [x1 - pw, z1 - pw], [x1 - pw, z0 + pw]]
          }
          inset = lambda do |quad, d0, d1| # the strip between d0 and d1 mm in from the outer edge
            o0, o1, i1, i0 = quad
            lerp = ->(a, c, k) { [a[0] + (c[0] - a[0]) * k, a[1] + (c[1] - a[1]) * k] }
            k0 = d0 / pw
            k1 = d1 / pw
            [lerp.call(o0, i0, k0), lerp.call(o1, i1, k0), lerp.call(o1, i1, k1), lerp.call(o0, i0, k1)]
          end
          bars.each_value do |q|
            grain = (q[0][1] - q[1][1]).abs < 0.01 ? 'x' : 'z'
            prism(name, 'front', al, 'y', y0, y1 - y0, inset.call(q, 0.0, b), grain, '', fx)
            prism(name, 'front', al, 'y', y0 + gt, y1 - y0 - gt, inset.call(q, b, pw), grain, '', fx)
          end
          panel('Glass', 'front', Params::GLASS_MAT, x0 + b, x1 - b, y0, y0 + gt, z0 + b, z1 - b, 'y', 'z', '', fx)
          hw("Black aluminium glass door #{fmt w} × #{fmt h} mm (#{fmt pw} × #{fmt Params::GLASS_PROFILE_T} mm profile, #{fmt gt} mm bronze glass)", 1)
        end

        # Full-length "G" profile along one edge, filling the strip taken off the panel:
        # back wall, top plate, a finger lip hanging at the front, and a base plate on the panel.
        def pull_profile(side, x0, x1, z0, z1, h, yf, yb, mat, mv)
          w = 2.0
          lip = [[f('profile_grip'), h - 2 * w - 2].min, w + 1].max
          # (d = distance in from the outer edge, y) — d 0 is the edge, d h the panel joint
